claims.claim: Mistral AI Platform bills per model usage, and prompts, completions, uploaded files, agents, and workflow data can be sensitive.
claims.summary: The Mistral AI Platform API is a paid, bearer-key-authenticated platform; prompts, completions, files, agents, and workflow data are caller data.

claims.claim: Keep `MISTRAL_API_KEY` out of source, shell history, inputs, logs, and chat.
claims.summary: The fixed mistralai/platform-docs-public revision (openapi-public-doc.yaml) declares a single ApiKey HTTP bearer security scheme for the developer surface.

claims.claim: Chat Completions, FIM, Agents conversations, Audio transcription/speech, and Workflows event/log Endpoints stream responses as Server-Sent Events.
claims.summary: The fixed official openapi-public-doc.yaml declares text/event-stream responses on 11 ApiKey Endpoints (chat completions, FIM, audio transcription/speech, three Agents conversation stream variants, and four Workflows streams).

claims.claim: Agents conversation streams emit named events such as `conversation.response.started`, `message.output.delta`, `tool.execution.started`, and `tool.execution.done`; unknown future events must be preserved, not dropped.
claims.summary: The official Agents streaming guide documents these named SSE events with sample payloads and lists agent.handoff.started/done, conversation.response.done/error, and function.call.delta.

claims.claim: For large or asynchronous workloads prefer Batch jobs over live inference. OCR Endpoints extract structured text from documents. Audio Endpoints cover transcription, speech synthesis, and voice management.
claims.summary: The official API reference (docs.mistral.ai/api) and the fixed spec document Batch job management, OCR, and Audio (transcriptions, speech, voices) Endpoints.
